items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: No, no. It was not Newman.

ctx.x: Newman was his name, wasn't it?

No, no. It was not Newman. So he went for my tone on the trombone, and for the tune, 'Caravan.' So in the next two or three weeks, he came to the Cotton Club with all kind of contraptions and everything about 'Caravan.' You know how much he gave me?
